title: Make prompt-permission creation-key retries return retained identity without a new mutation
outcome: An exact operator creation-key retry recovers the original permission, including revoked history, before new-version and fresh-proof admission checks, without bumping federation version or rewriting durable data. Conflicting scope reuse remains refused.
acceptance: A lost-reply exact retry with its original version returns the retained identity without a second mutation; conflicting or revived reuse is refused.
Grant recovery remains possible after the original consent changes, as a historical identity read that grants no new authority.
Behavioral tests cover consent and grant retry, conflict and revocation cases.
